description: strategy-mcp is an open source MCP server that exposes professional-grade product strategy frameworks as structured tools. Any MCP-compatible AI assistant (Claude, Cursor, Cline) can install it and immediately get access to structured strategy analysis, RICE, JTBD, competitive positioning, assumption mapping, and more.
